info.name: DevMentor API — Complete Collection
info.description:
# DevMentor Backend API — Complete Collection (2026)

**Credit-Based Mentorship, Cohort Classrooms & Code Review Marketplace Platform**

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup & Configuration

1. **Environment Variables**:
   - **Production (Default)**: `https://dev-mentor-server.vercel.app/api/v1`
   - **Local Development**: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
   - Switch between them via the collection variable `baseUrl`.

2. **Authentication Flow**:
   - Execute **Login (Get Token)** in the `🔐 Authentication` folder.
   - The test script automatically extracts the Bearer token and updates:
     - `{{token}}` (active token used across the entire collection)
     - `{{adminToken}}`, `{{mentorToken}}`, or `{{studentToken}}` depending on who logs in.

3. **Global Bearer Token**:
   - The collection root is configured with Bearer Token auth using `{{token}}`. All protected endpoints inherit this automatically!

---

## 👥 Demo Platform Credentials (3 Roles)

| Role | Email | Password | Primary Capabilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Admin** | `admin@devmentor.com` | `Admin@123456` | User & Mentor Moderation, Cohort Approval, Payout Processing, Global Financial Analytics |
| **Mentor** | `mentor@devmentor.com` | `Mentor@123456` | Create Cohorts, Deliver 1-on-1 Sprints, Review Code Snippets, Build Exams, Request Cash-Out |
| **Student** | `student@devmentor.com` | `Student@123456` | Top-up Wallet via bKash, Book Sprints, Enroll in Cohorts, Request Code Reviews, Take Exams |

---

## 💰 Economy & Credit System
- **1 Credit = 4 BDT** (e.g. 200 BDT deposit = 50 Credits)
- **QUICK Code Review** = 10 Credits (24-Hour SLA)
- **DEEP Code Review** = 50 Credits (48-Hour SLA)
- **1-on-1 Sprint Session** = Configurable (default 10 Credits)
- **Cohort Enrollment** = Fixed Credit Price set by Mentor
